tools.trigger_when: every repository-owned HTTP or sitemap request
rendered DOM evidence can change the decision and trusted_render_target=true
SEO supplies a bounded runtime URL set from GSC, Ahrefs, sitemap or another source
the caller explicitly requests sitewide scope with a hard URL cap
technical crawl output must be consumed, related or compared

crawl_scopes.bounded: exact explicit runtime URL set; SiteOne uses --single-page and does not expand discovered page links
crawl_scopes.sitewide: same-scope page discovery with an explicit max URL cap; completeness is valid only when crawl-scope.json says scope_complete=true

allowed: maximum 500 public runtime URLs selected by SEO from GSC/Ahrefs/sitemap/other evidence
optional prior SEO Audit run id for compatible regression comparison

boundaries: GSC remains authoritative for owned Google Search performance and Google's observed index status.
Ahrefs remains authoritative only for its own market, keyword, backlink and competitive datasets.
This repository owns reproducible technical observations, scope metadata, normalized technical evidence and regression comparison only.
Bounded and sitewide scopes are separate contracts and must never be silently conflated.
Rendered browser evidence and HTTP-response evidence retain separate observation-layer labels.
Browser rendering is fail-closed unless trusted_render_target=true because browser subresources are not constrained by the crawler top-document scope.
Rendered SiteOne JSON has an explicit coverage boundary; non-exported rendered head relations require dedicated browser DOM evidence when decision-relevant.
A sitewide completeness claim is invalid when the crawl cap is reached or crawl-scope.json says scope_complete=false.
A regression claim requires a compatible prior run validated for repository, workflow, target and runtime scope before diffing.
External URL selection does not import external source semantics into repository output.
Tool findings are diagnostics; SEO owns interpretation and prioritization.
The evidence manifest records provenance and artifacts; it does not replace Project SEO source truth.
Client, target and run-specific truth belongs in runtime input or artifacts, not permanently on main.
